program.title: BSc in Biotechnology
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 0-3, 0-1, 3-7, 15-18).

The program consists of a common core plus Track Study: students follow one of the mutually exclusive tracks (Applied Bioscience, Entrepreneurship, International Research Enrichment); the track credits are included in the calculated total but a student completes only one track.

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. LIFS 1901/1903 exemptions, capstone alternatives, CHEM 2111/2311, CHEM 2155/2355), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.
The elective list also allows 'Any LIFS courses at 3000/4000-level' beyond the explicitly listed courses, so the recorded elective course list is not exhaustive.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 BIOT (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
